Title: 2025 Peru Missions Trip
Excerpt: Casa del Aguila is an orphanage, school, and farm in Limatambo, Peru. CFC has partnered with Casa del Aguila and Casa del Proa for many years — join us in praying for this vital ministry.
Content: Casa del Aguila is an orphanage, school, and farm in Limatambo, Peru. CFC has partnered with Casa del Aguila and Casa del Proa for many years. Pray for this vital ministry and the team that travels to serve there each year.

Title: 2024 Ghana Kids Camp
Excerpt: Markaz Al-Bishara Ministries in Tamale, Ghana has been one of CFC's partners in global outreach for more than 20 years. This year 550 children from across northern Ghana, Benin, and Burkina Faso gathered for four days to learn that "God knows me."
